# fish completion for jet (generated by `jet completions fish`)
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a run -d 'build, then run a program (or a project)'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a check -d 'look for problems, build nothing'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a test -d 'compile and run top-level test blocks'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a build -d 'compile to a native binary in ./build/'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a new -d 'create a new project folder'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a fmt -d 'rewrite a file to canonical style'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a fix -d 'apply all auto-fixable diagnostics in place'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a explain -d 'print the offline essay for a diagnostic code'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a doctor -d 'diagnose the toolchain and offer fixes'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a env -d 'enter the project dev shell'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a bind -d 'generate a C binding cache from a header'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a add -d 'add a dependency and fetch it'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a remove -d 'remove a dependency'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a fetch -d 'download and link all dependencies'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a update -d 'refresh moving dependency selectors'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a store -d 'inspect or verify the package store'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a gc -d 'remove unreferenced store entries'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a completions -d 'print shell completions (bash | zsh | fish)'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a man -d 'print the jet man page (roff)'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a lsp -d 'language server (stdio JSON-RPC)'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a version -d 'print compiler version'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a upgrade -d 'how to download a newer release'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a help -d 'print the help text'
complete -c jet -l json -d 'emit machine-readable diagnostics'
complete -c jet -l color -d 'color: auto | always | never'
complete -c jet -l version -d 'print compiler version'
complete -c jet -l emit-rust -d 'also print the generated Rust code'
complete -c jet -l check -d 'with fmt: exit 1 if the file would change'
complete -c jet -l small -d 'with build/run: smallest binary (S15)'
complete -c jet -l locked -d 'with fetch: verify only, refuse network'
complete -c jet -l annotated -d 'with new: include commented example deps'
complete -c jet -l verbose -d 'with build: print the bridge steps'
complete -c jet -l online -d 'with doctor: allow network checks'
complete -c jet -l fix -d 'with doctor: apply auto-fixable problems'
complete -c jet -l dry-run -d 'with fix: show changes without writing'
